description: Soft-delete N SeoScoredKeyword rows in one call (sets deletedAt; rows stay in the DB but are filtered out of all queries). Housekeeping op — not part of the main flow. Pass `confirm: true` to proceed. Use to clear out a batch of junk/irrelevant keywords the auto-pipeline missed, e.g. after filtering seo_list_keywords by relevanceMax.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm bulk soft-delete
